source.title: Single-cell transcriptomes and whole-brain projections of serotonin neurons in the mouse dorsal and median raphe nuclei

confidence_rationale: High-quality primary anatomy (plate-based scRNA-seq + intersectional viral tracing + whole-brain projection mapping + single-cell reconstruction) from a leading lab. Establishes the load-bearing anatomical PREMISE of the receptor layer's level-split: dorsal and median raphe serotonin neurons are molecularly distinct and target segregated fields, with VGLUT3+ DR neurons preferentially innervating cortex and a separate subcortical-projecting population. It does NOT itself test the REE exclusivity (MECH-006) or terrain (MECH-085) mechanisms, nor the receptor-subtype assignment -- it grounds the possibility of a two-source, two-target architecture. Mouse data; confidence held to mid-range by that interpretive gap and species transfer.
failure_signatures: The paper shows DR->cortex preference for the VGLUT3+ subset, not a clean DR->cortex / MR->hippocampus dichotomy; the hippocampus/septum is innervated by both nuclei, so the receptor layer's tidy DR-cortical vs MR-hippocampal mapping is an idealisation of a more graded projection field.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Dorsal and median raphe serotonin neurons form transcriptomically distinct clusters that map to principal-DR, caudal-DR, or MR, and these molecular subtypes differ in their whole-brain axonal targets: DR serotonin neurons co-expressing VGLUT3 preferentially innervate the cortex, whereas other subtypes (e.g. TRH-co-expressing) innervate subcortical regions such as the hypothalamus.
mapping.ree_translation: The receptor-subtype layer reconciles the MECH-006 vs MECH-085 serotonin conflict by assigning the cortical/narrative-exclusivity motif to one raphe-receptor population and the hippocampal-terrain/basin-depth motif to another. Ren et al. supply the anatomical precondition: there genuinely are molecularly and projection-distinct raphe serotonin populations targeting different forebrain fields, so 're-using the same serotonergic motif at different hierarchical levels' is anatomically licensed rather than ad hoc.
mapping.mapping_caveat: This is grounding for the ANATOMICAL PREMISE only. The paper says nothing about 5-HT2A vs 5-HT1A receptors (it characterises the presynaptic source, not the postsynaptic receptor), nor about exclusivity/terrain computation. The DR-cortex preference is for a molecular subset, and both nuclei innervate hippocampus to some degree -- so the clean DR->cortex / MR->hippocampus split the layer draws is a simplification.
mapping.source_context: Mouse; scRNA-seq + intersectional viral-genetic anterograde tracing + single-neuron reconstruction.

confidence_components.notes: Source quality very high; mapping_fidelity is the limiting factor because the paper grounds the projection-architecture premise, not the receptor assignment or the REE computation. Transfer risk moderate (mouse anatomy -> human-framed REE planes).
